issue.title: Investigate sase-core 0.34 notification-store 5k load slowdown
issue.description: Full CI perf-floors showed notification_store.synthetic_5k.notification_store_5k_load_snapshot medians rose about 21 percent after the sase-core 0.34 step between CI runs 34479600173 and 34594086333. This release-CI unblock only widens the SASE per-anchor floor to keep releases flowing; investigate in sase-core whether the load cost is intended or reducible.

task_type_fields.impact: Full CI perf-floors consumed the old release headroom and can normalize a real core-side load regression if not investigated.
task_type_fields.repro: Compare tests/perf/baselines/phase7_regression_floor.json anchor notification_store.synthetic_5k.notification_store_5k_load_snapshot across CI runs 34479600173 and 34594086333; rerun just phase7-perf-check against core 0.34.x.
